star.situation: Throughout my career I've had opportunities to lead projects and crews in environments ranging from healthcare and recreation to oil and gas.

star.result: I've found that when people feel supported, trusted and understand what's expected of them, they're more engaged, produce better work and take greater ownership of the outcome.

cards.question: Tell us about a time you coached or mentored someone.

cards.question: Tell us about a conflict with a coworker.

star.result: Most conflicts were resolved quickly because everyone felt heard, expectations were clarified and we were able to move forward professionally.

star.action: I'd speak with each person individually to understand their perspective, bring them together for a respectful discussion, focus on facts rather than personalities, establish clear expectations and follow up afterward to ensure the issue stayed resolved.
star.result: My objective would be to rebuild trust, improve communication and prevent the conflict from affecting the rest of the team.

star.result: I've found that people respond much better when they understand the reason behind the feedback and know you're genuinely invested in helping them improve.

star.result: Today I see delegation as developing people rather than simply assigning work. It allows the team to grow while giving me the capacity to focus on planning and improving operations.

star.result: When trust is established, communication improves, problems are identified earlier and people become much more willing to take ownership of their work.

cards.question: How would you deal with an underperforming employee?
